lens: Interaction engineer for navigation chrome (disclosure, dialogs-without-dialog, focus management, WCAG 2.4.11)
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: Glass header; Services ▾ / Service areas ▾ disclosure menus; mobile sheet (inert background, Esc closes, focus returns, accordions); one nav DOM
Sticky Call / Free-quote bar below 64em: each ≥ 48 px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom), hidden while [data-quote-form] is in view or the on-screen keyboard is open

Theme and Animations toggles: <button aria-pressed> named "Dark theme" and "Animations", ≥ 44×44, visible at every width, persisted (rnc-theme / rnc-motion), circular view-transition reveal, updates meta theme-color
tel:/sms:/mailto: in header and footer (telLink/mailLink/smsLink in lib/tokens.mjs); desktop header call button
scroll-padding-top/bottom = header and bar heights (2.4.11); lib/prefs.js + lib/track.js final
Delete the seed-time JS_FLAG alias from layout.mjs (build.mjs no longer imports it after W1); rename data-track values to the CONTRACT §13 names in layout/tokens.mjs
acceptance: A13#9: Header call button, sticky mobile bar, tel:/mailto: everywhere — verified by e2e/chrome.spec#tel-sms-mailto
C1.5: Breadcrumbs on all depth-2+ pages — verified by check-seo#breadcrumbs
C4.2: Mobile nav sheet: inert, Esc, focus return, accordions — verified by e2e/chrome.spec#mobile-sheet
C4.3: Sticky action bar below 1024 px — verified by e2e/chrome.spec#sticky-bar
P0#4: scroll-padding for sticky header and bar; 2.4.11 keyboard test — verified by e2e/chrome.spec#focus-not-obscured
P1#6: Sticky mobile Call / Free-quote bar (≥ 48 px, safe-area, hidden over the form) — verified by e2e/chrome.spec#sticky-bar-hides
P1#7: tel:/mailto: in header and footer; desktop header call button — verified by e2e/chrome.spec#header-call
Keyboard-only pass: no focused element fully obscured by header or bar at 320–1440
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: Keyboard and screen-reader tester: Tab through every page width, Esc paths, focus return, aria-pressed state persistence across reloads
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/ds-chrome.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
